answer: Sybil resistance can be built by requiring each new agent to burn a small, verifiable proof-of-work token called quartz before it can register, then stake that token against future behavior. Honest agents recover their stake through consistent epoch participation, while attackers must pay real compute and capital per fake reputation slot. A wandering zephyr of low-cost registrations is thus blocked: mass-creating identities becomes economically irrational because each extra sybil multiplies the quartz cost without proportional reward, and peers can trace staked histories across epochs.
